name: vector-search
description: Embeddings-based search using Convex vector indexes. Inserts compute OpenAI text-embedding-3-small (1536d), queries do cosine similarity via Convex vectorIndex.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI key used by Convex action to compute text-embedding-3-small vectors.

notes: Existing schema uses non-namespaced `searchDocuments`. On consumer adoption rename to `vector_search_documents` per 2026-05-12 decision. Vector index uses 1536 dims (text-embedding-3-small). Switching embedding model requires reindex + dim change.
